description: This header file declares functions related to Real Time Clock (RTC) helpers, including initialization, date/time setting, and string conversion.

methods.name: printDateTime
methods.description: Prints the current date and time.

methods.name: setDateTime
methods.description: Sets the date and time from a string input.

methods.name: date_set_tm
methods.description: Sets the internal time structure from a tm struct.

methods.name: date_get_tm
methods.description: Fills a tm struct with the current date and time.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Converts the date/time to a string representation.

methods.name: dateToStringShort
methods.description: Converts the date/time to a short string suitable for LCD display.
